svg.title: CausalAttentionKernel step by step
svg.text: CausalAttentionKernel, block (head 4, row 4): "is" attends to keys 0–4
Layer 1 on "The capital of France is", real values, BF16 cache. 128 threads = 4 warps, head_dim 128.
kv_head = 4 / (12 / 2) = 0, so keys and values come from KV head 0 (shared by heads 0–5).
PagedRow(pages, 4, j) = pages[j >> 4] · 16 + (j & 15): keys 0–4 are rows 0–4 of page pages[0].
1 Scores: warp w takes keys j = w, w + 4, …
Lane l adds query[d] · k_j[d] for d = l, l+32, l+64, l+96 (dashed: lane 0). WarpSum adds the 32 lane sums;
lane 0 writes weights[j] = dot · scale, scale = 1/√128. Key 4 is warp 0's second key (j = 0 + 4).
2 Softmax: thread j owns weights[j]; threads 5–127 hold no key
3 Mix: thread d sums weights[j] · v_j[d] over j = 0..4; threads d and d+1 read neighbouring floats
pick the KV head and the sequence's page table; copy the query row to shared memory
warps over keys, lanes over dims, WarpSum; one score per visible key in shared memory
block max, e^(s − max), block sum, scale by 1 / sum
one output dim per thread, summed over every visible key's value
